start: Today, owner signed in, gym online and on its free trial

steps.action: Open Today and read the trial line
user_sees: A quiet line with the day the free trial ends; in the last days and after the end it turns strong and shows the links 'Pay MettleUp' and the price list
must_not: Anything locked when the trial ends
The line shown to staff, in the demo gym or for a browser-only gym
A wrong end date

user_sees: Page 'Pay MettleUp', 'Pay for your MettleUp plan by UPI or bank transfer', 'Back to Settings'; a line saying the plan now; '1. Pick your plan' with Starter / Pro and '1 month' / '1 year'
must_not: A price that differs from the public price list
Pro picked and charged without the owner seeing the amount

user_sees: The big amount with 'for 1 year'; during the trial a line saying when the paid time starts; 'The price for one branch. More than one branch? Message MettleUp for your total before you pay.'
must_not: Paid time starting before the trial ends without saying so
The 'Amount paid' box left on the old plan's price

steps.action: Under '2. Pay {amount}' scan the QR with a UPI app and pay
user_sees: 'Scan with any UPI app (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, your bank’s app). The amount is filled in.', the QR, 'On a phone? Pay with a UPI app', UPI ID, Name, and 'In the payment note, write your gym code {code} so we know it is you.'
must_not: A QR or UPI ID that is not MettleUp's
An amount in the QR that differs from the amount on screen

steps.action: Under '3. I have paid' pick 'UPI', type the 12-digit reference in 'Reference number (UTR)', check 'Amount paid', send
user_sees: Toast 'Sent. MettleUp will check the payment and confirm it here.'
The page scrolls to the top; 'Your payments' shows the payment waiting for confirmation
must_not: The plan switched on before MettleUp confirms
The same reference accepted twice
A sent proof that does not show in 'Your payments'

start: Settings, owner signed in, gym online

steps.action: Open Settings and tap the Pay MettleUp row
user_sees: The same 'Pay MettleUp' page
must_not: The row shown to staff

steps.action: Under '2.' use 'Or pay by bank transfer (NEFT or IMPS)', then under '3.' pick 'Bank transfer' and type the UTR
user_sees: Account name, Account number, IFSC, Bank
Hint 'The UTR number your bank shows for the transfer.'
The same sent toast
must_not: The UPI 12-digit rule applied to a bank UTR
Bank details missing with no word why

steps.action: Leave the reference empty or type 5 digits for UPI, send
user_sees: An error under 'Reference number (UTR)'; nothing sent
must_not: A proof sent with no reference

steps.action: Clear 'Amount paid' or type letters, send
user_sees: 'Type the amount you paid, in rupees, like 1499.'
must_not: A proof sent with amount zero
An amount in paise taken as rupees

steps.action: Send while the server refuses (reference already used, or too many tries)
user_sees: A plain reason in a red line above the form; the typed reference is still in the box
must_not: A raw server code
The typed reference wiped

start: Pay MettleUp page when it cannot work

steps.action: Open #/settings/mettleup signed in as staff, or with a browser-only gym
user_sees: Staff are kept off the page; an owner without an online gym sees 'Only the gym owner can pay MettleUp' and 'Sign in as the owner, with the gym online, to pay.'
must_not: MettleUp's bank details shown to staff
An endless 'Loading…'

steps.action: Open it on a gym whose server does not have this part yet
user_sees: 'Paying MettleUp here is not ready yet' and 'To pay now, message MettleUp and we will send you the payment details. Your gym keeps working as it is.'
must_not: An error page
No way shown to message MettleUp

steps.action: Open it when MettleUp has not added payment details
user_sees: 'Payment is not available yet' and 'MettleUp has not added its payment details here yet. Message MettleUp to pay. Your gym keeps working as it is.'
must_not: An empty QR
A step 3 form with nowhere to pay

start: Pay MettleUp, a proof was sent

steps.action: Open the page again before MettleUp checks
user_sees: 'Your payments' with the newest 5, each with a pill (waiting) and a line of words
must_not: The proof missing after a refresh
The trial line on Today gone before the payment is confirmed

steps.action: Open the page after MettleUp confirms
user_sees: The pill turns good; the top line says the plan and the day it is paid until; the Today line is gone until the last days of the paid time
must_not: Paid time counted from the wrong day
Two paid periods for one payment

steps.action: Open the page after MettleUp refuses the proof
user_sees: The pill turns bad with the reason; steps 1 to 3 still work to send again
must_not: A refused payment counted as paid
No word on what to do next

steps.action: Open the page in the last days of a paid month
user_sees: Today says 'Your MettleUp plan is paid until {day}. Pay for the next month or year to keep going.'; after the day: 'Your MettleUp plan was paid until {day}. Pay to keep going. Your members’ app keeps working.'
must_not: The members' app or the panel locked
The line shown for a lifetime plan

steps.action: Read what the page shows and what the proof stores
user_sees: MettleUp's own UPI ID and bank account; this gym's last 5 payments, plan and gym code
must_not: Another gym's payments or plan
The owner's UPI app details or card stored
Staff or members able to read the gym's plan payments
